name: Hollow Mirror Saint
loreTies: An Empyrean-shaped absence that reflects protection into imprisonment; it proves order can be imitated without mercy.
Creates shield zones that help Hollow units unless shattered by coordinated strikes.
Erasure is not death; erasure is ownership without memory.
shortBackstory: Hollow Mirror Saint is a Hollow threat creature built for campaign and event encounters, turning erased memory into elite battlefield pressure.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Hollow Mirror Saint formed where the Hollow learned a specific weakness in remembered civilization. It is not a Deity, not a citizen, and not a recruitable unit; it is a symptom of the Gate giving absence a body.

chapters.title: Hollow Function
chapters.text: Its role inside the Hollow threat faction is precise: Creates shield zones that help Hollow units unless shattered by coordinated strikes. This lets mission designers select it by encounter tags instead of treating Hollow enemies as one shapeless swarm.

chapters.title: Lore Tie
chapters.text: An Empyrean-shaped absence that reflects protection into imprisonment; it proves order can be imitated without mercy.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: Hollow Mirror Saint can appear in Normal missions, Elite remixes, Hollow Breach events, Ascension floors, and raid add waves when its tags match the objective pressure. It must always reinforce Hollowing: isolation, corrupted memory, broken objectives, or stolen meaning.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Art and gameplay must keep Hollow Mirror Saint visibly non-playable. Its silhouette uses winglike negative-space guardian with broken aura mirror, porcelain mask fragments, chain-light without warmth. while its abilities — False Sanctuary, Reflect Mercy, Aura Lock — create battlefield pressure without confusing it for a faction Titan.
